source_name: 54_01_图片库＆设计资源_中文_女士_Chanel_Pre-Summer_2027_服装__054_media_cha_biarritz_ps27_046_text_description.md
text_description: A tailored red-and-black plaid look shown from head to upper thigh, built around a cropped, structured jacket and matching high-waisted bottom. The jacket sits at the natural waist with squared shoulders, long sleeves, a neat round/stand neckline, black edging along the front opening, and rows of shiny gold crest-style buttons visible on the front and cuffs; a long black scarf-like lapel or stole is draped from the neck down both sides of the torso, hanging past the jacket hem. Underneath is a close-cut black plunge bodice or swimsuit-like top with cream/white bust panels, a deep V opening, and a central gold ring/heart-shaped hardware detail creating a small keyhole at the bust. The matching red plaid lower piece begins high on the waist, fastened or accented with small gold buttons, and features a high front slit exposing one thigh; the skirt/trouser length continues out of frame. At both hips/front sides, graphic bordered panels in black, white, orange, and green appear layered like pocket flaps or scarf-print inserts, adding contrast against the plaid. Styling is polished and fashion-forward, with visible gold earrings, a vivid red tartan palette, black contrast trim, metallic button accents, and sharp tailoring mixed with revealing lingerie-like layering.
